name: Houjou Tomoe
source: The school nurse and one of Kirito's numerous lovers.  She is a (extremely weak) Devil Hunter assigned to watch the Hunters at the academy by Houjou, though she is much lower in rank than Misora.  She is far closer to humanity than most Hunters, but this just means she is much less psychologically 'adapted' to the needs of their lives.
